summary: p11 closes the two root causes p10 left open: the eternal puddles=0 (a debounce that needed clamped-dt seconds the render loop never produces) and the river-density blocker (mid-band red now 6.3-10.9% against the reference's 5.6%, with readable streaks and no wall - the first bracket overcorrected to 20.9% and was pulled back in-round, which is exactly what the measurement loop is for). Spray climbs again (coherent mist, ~5/10), columns carry hot cores, the black floor holds, and zero console errors everywhere. What holds the score at 8.25 instead of 8.5 is the viewer's own band: the foreground the camera stands on still reads 2x dim at the top end with a fraction of the reference's red, the spray is mist rather than curtain, and the night pool speculars retain dither residue. The module has gone from 'no mirror at all' (p6) to 'reference-density mid-field rivers' (p11); what remains is brightness where the viewer stands and texture polish.
